dependencyBoundary: The suite ran in a fresh Python process using the existing isolated Python 3.13.11 environment. This was not a clean-room dependency installation or an independently provisioned environment.
limits: Local Darwin arm64 reproduction of bounded Git runtime, policy, scheduler, and deterministic MCP stdio-peer tests only.
No external model, client host, live MCP server, real-source workload, network, or CI was used.
Passing tests do not establish semantic correctness of arbitrary operations, speedup, cross-platform behavior, utility, or whole-M4 acceptance.
The first full-run failure remains part of the record and must be disclosed alongside the distinct corrected-environment pass.
